fields.title: Estimate index size
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Polka has 8 million orders. The PM wants an order amount filter on the admin screen, which is opened twice a week.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Roughly how much space will an index on a single numeric field take?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: How many times a day will the database update it if 20 thousand orders are created daily and each changes status three times?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Is it worth creating the index?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: about 200–400 MB — any answer between 100 MB and 1 GB is acceptable, order of magnitude matters more than the exact number. Updates — 20,000 creations + 60,000 modifications = 80 thousand per day. For eight screen views a month, this is a bad deal: 10 thousand index updates per single view. The right solution is a nightly report in a separate store. General rule: divide maintenance cost by usage frequency.
